by_minutes_only.why: the natural default without the kitchen's part: the whole pool by minutes, cooks and servers alike

an_hour_minimum.why: guesses the usual hour for the shortest shift that counts, so a 76-minute shift gets a share

over_77_minutes.why: off by one: only shifts longer than 77 minutes count, so exactly 77 gets nothing

weekends_all_floor.why: gives the floor the whole pool at weekends, Saturdays as well as Sundays
